Name: Meadow Farm Style Farm Buildings (CP)(AT)
Author: Gurrabird
Description:
[size=4][b]Description:[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=4]These [CP] and [AT] versions of Stardew Valley's farm buildings are designed to coordinate with the look of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp Remastered[/url]'s Meadow Farm house and other Meadow Farm style buildings and mods. Included are all versions of the Farmhouse, Coop, Barn, Shed and Cabins as well as the Greenhouse, Mill, Silo, Slime Hut, Stable and Well. The Shipping Bin, Mailbox, Doghouse, Pet Bowl and Fish Pond are also included.[/size][/color]


[size=4][b]Installation: [/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][b][u][AT] Alternative Textures version: [/u][/b]
Download and install/unzip the [AT] version into your mods folder. Once installed, use the paint bucket to select textures.

[b][u][CP] Content Patcher version:[/u][/b]
Download and install/unzip the [CP] version into your mods folder. Once installed, any existing or newly constructed farm buildings should have this style. If you have other Content Patcher farm building mods installed, you may need to select this one specifically, disable the others in the Generic Mod Config Menu or remove them from your mods folder. 

[i]Customization options in the Generic Mod Config Menu:[/i][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Select to disable/enable any of the buildings in this mod if you want to mix and match with other building textures. Default setting is selected/enabled for all buildings.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pick Upgraded Farmhouse Design: Choose to use the standard architecture or an alternate design for the second Farmhouse upgrade.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Barn Door Style: Choose between decorative or X-brace.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stable Roof: Choose tiles, planks or shingles for the roof. All stable roofs connect neatly with the left-side of the standard Farmhouse.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stable Style: Choose a style for the front of the stable.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Shipping Bin Style: Choose between red, wood panel or wood slats.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Doghouse Style: Choose to have red decorative shutters or no shutters.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Dark Doghouse Stone Style: For the Dark Doghouse, choose one of two stone options.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pet Bowl Color: Choose a bowl color.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Pet Bowl Stone Type: Choose one of two stone options.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Enable Painting: Select to enable paint masks for paintable buildings (see image with paintable inventory).[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[i]About painting:[/i][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Select to enable paint masks and apply your own colors to these buildings using Robin's Paint menu. Disabling will ignore any paint colors applied with Robin's Paint menu and revert to the default Meadow Farm style colors.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Default setting is painting disabled.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]If you disable this mod or any buildings in this mod after painting your own colors, those colors will usually remain assigned to the unmodded buildings. [/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Painting can be enabled for the Farmhouse, Barn, Big Barn, Deluxe Barn, Coop, Big Coop, Deluxe Coop, Shed, Big Shed, Cabins, Greenhouse, Mill, Silo, Slime Hut, Stable and Well.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Not paintable: Shipping Bin, Mailbox, Doghouse and Fish Pond.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Painting the Pet Bowl continues to work as it does in the unmodded game and switches between default, stone or hay floor versions.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Note: When painting is not enabled for a paintable building, the paint menu can still be opened but the ability to paint is disabled.[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Alternative Textures / Required only for AT version[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher / Required only for CP versions[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley Expanded[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Generic Mod Config Menu[/color][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Credits and appreciation:[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Lemurkat/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp Remastered[/url] for the unique look of the Meadow Farmhouse that this is based on and permission to post this.
Atravita/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17700]More Paint Masks[/url] for the inspiration and guiding example in making normally unpaintable buildings paintable.[/color]
